title: Bharat Hain Hum
description: Krish, Trish & Baltiboy Bharat Hain HumKTB Bharat Hai HumThe journey of some of the most prominent yet unrecognised freedom fighters who played a pivotal role in securing independence from the British.India has been attacked by so many foreign invaders for its riches. We had to fight so many battles till we eventually won our freedom from the British on 15th of August, 1947. The iconic trio Krish, Trish and Baltiboy present the stories about the heroes who fought the war of freedom. This series attempts to bring alive glorious tales of valour and sacrifice using the medium of animation.
